title: kith-tslocal: WhoIs client over Unix socket
description:
Implement async whois(addr: SocketAddr) -> Result<WhoIsResponse, AuthError> over Unix socket.

What: HTTP GET /localapi/v0/whois?addr=<ip:port> to tailscaled Unix socket.

Available: hyper 1.9.0, hyper-util 0.1.20 (tokio feature), tokio UnixStream.

Algorithm:
1. Define struct LocalApiClient { socket_path: String } with new(path: &str) -> Self
2. Implement whois(&self, addr: SocketAddr) -> Result<WhoIsResponse, AuthError>:
   a. Format addr as 'ip:port' string for query param
   b. Connect: tokio::net::UnixStream::connect(&self.socket_path).await map_err -> WhoIsFailed
   c. Wrap: hyper_util::rt::TokioIo::new(stream)
   d. Handshake: hyper::client::conn::http1::handshake(io).await map_err -> WhoIsFailed
   e. Spawn connection task: tokio::spawn(async move { conn.await })
   f. Build request: Request::builder().method('GET').uri('/localapi/v0/whois?addr=<addr>').header('Host', 'local').body(http_body_util::Empty::new())
   g. Send: sender.send_request(req).await map_err -> WhoIsFailed
   h. Check status: if !resp.status().is_success() -> WhoIsFailed('HTTP <status>')
   i. Collect body: http_body_util::BodyExt::collect(resp.into_body()).await -> bytes
   j. Size check: if bytes.len() > 102_400 -> WhoIsFailed('response too large')
   k. Parse JSON: serde_json::from_slice(&bytes) map_err -> WhoIsFailed
   l. Validate: if result.user_profile.id.is_empty() -> WhoIsFailed('empty user_id')
   m. Validate: if result.user_profile.id.contains('\0') -> WhoIsFailed('null byte in user_id')
   n. Return Ok(result)
3. Socket path default: const DEFAULT_SOCKET: &str = '/var/run/tailscale/tailscaled.sock'

Defensive rules:
- All network errors -> AuthError::WhoIsFailed(String), never panic or unwrap
- Size limit 100KB enforced BEFORE serde parse
- Validate user_profile.id non-empty and no null bytes
- Do NOT log user_id or login_name in error messages
- Wrap ALL await errors with context string ('connecting to tailscaled', 'sending whois request', etc.)
- addr format for IPv6: SocketAddr Display already formats as [::1]:port

Agent team: standard (R + I + T)
Tests: separate bead KITH-3oh
